spans.s:
चट r. 1st. and 10th cls. (चटति, चाटयति-ते)
 1. To break, to pierce.
 2. To
kill, to injure. भ्वादि-पर-सक-सेट् । वधे भेदे च चुरा-उभ-सक-सेट् ।

चाट m. (-टः) A cheat, a rogue, a peculator, one who makes away with
money &c. entrusted to him.
 E. चट् to injure, affix अच् ।

चटक m. (-कः) A sparrow.
 f. (-का)
 1. A hen-sparrow.
 2. A young hen-
sparrow.
 3. The root of long pepper: see चटकाशिरस् and चटिका.
E. चट् to break, क्वुन् affix, braking corn, &c. चटति भिनत्ति धान्यादिकम् ।

चटकाशिरस् n. (-रः) The root of long pepper: see चटिकाशिरस्; also
mas. चटकाशिरस् (-राः).

चटिका f. (-का)
 1. The root of long pepper.
 2. A sparrow: see चटका,
&c. चट-वा-इकन्.

चटिकाशिरस् mn. (-राः-रः) The root of long pepper.
 E. चटका a sparrow,
and शिरस् a head; resembling in colour the head of a sparrow; in
other forms चटका, चटिकाशिरस् and चटकाशिरस्, &c.

चटु mn. (-टुः-टु)
 1. Scream, screech.
 2. Kind or agreeable discourse.
 m.
(-टुः)
 1. The belly.
 2. A posture of devotion amongst ascetics. E.
चट् to break, &c, Uṇādi affix उन्; also चाटु.

चाटु mn. (-टुः-टु)
 1. Pleasing or grateful discourse.
 2. Distinct speech.
3. Flattery.
 E. चट् to break, (anger,) Uṇādi affix ञुण्; also चटु.

चटुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
 1. Tremulous, trembling.
 2. Shaking, moving.
 3.
Beautiful.
 f. (-ला) Lightning.
 E. चट् to hurt, to break, and उलच्
Uṇādi aff.

चटुलालस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Pleased with or desirous of flattery.
 E. चटु,
and लालस desirous.

चटुलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Tremulous and beautiful, beautiful as a soft
swimming eye, &c.
 E. चटु beautiful, and लोल shaking, trembling.

चाटुलोल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Elegantly tremulous.
 E. चाटु for चटु beautiful,
and लोल trembling.

चाटकैर m. (-रः) A young sparrow.
 E. चटक a sparrow, and ऐरक् aff.

चाटुकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Speaking agreeably or kindly.
 m. (-रः) A flat-
terer.
 E. चाटु and कार who makes. चाटुं करोति ।

चाटुपटु m. (-टुः) A jester, a buffoon.
 E. चाटु agreeable speech, and पटु
clever; also चाटुवटु. भण्डे । (भांँड) ।

चाटुवटु m. (-टुः) A jester.
 E. चाटु wit and वटु who utters: see चाटुपटु.

चाटुशत n. (-तं) Repeated coaxing, a hundred entreaties.
 E. चाटु and शत
a hundred.

Service.
 2

. Agreeable language.
 3. Flattery.
 E. चाटु
agreeable speech, and उक्ति saying.
